resources.string: SAHNAJ uses this service strictly to execute hands-free voice commands such as navigating back, going home, scrolling, opening apps, and clicking user-requested buttons. No personal data, passwords, or credentials are ever recorded or monitored.
Hands-free voice action executor for SAHNAJ
SahNaj AI default digital assistant for hands-free voice commands, screen assistance, and voice control.
SahNaj ko Android ka default digital assistant banayein taaki Home button long-press ya assistant gesture se SahNaj turant open ho.
